titles.romaji: true tears x Hanasaku Iroha x TARITARI: Utopia
titles.native: true tears×花咲くいろは×TARITARI ユートピア

description: Utopia is a song that was specially created for the True Tears x Hanasaku Iroha x Tari Tari Joint Festival Live featuring the seiyuu (voice actors) from the three series. P.A. Works produced a video of this song which is included in the the Blu-ray release of this event.
